Privacy

Privacy policy

Eurovision Games is a free browser-based party game. We do not sell data, we do not run third-party advertising, and we collect the minimum needed for the game to work. Last updated 2 November 2026.

PrivacyTermsCookiesAbout
  • No data salesEver. We're not in that business.
  • No cross-site tracking cookiesNo advertising or behavioural profiling.
  • No microphone or camera inputThe game is text and tap only.

What we collect

Four categories — what each is for, and how long we keep it. Nobody signs up: hosts and players alike play in an anonymous session, and we never ask for an email address or real name.

Data typePurposeRetention
Anonymous session IDA random ID created automatically when you create or join a room, so the app knows which player and which rooms are yours. No email, password or real name is attached to it.Stored in your browser until you clear its site data. The matching record on our side holds no personal details.
Player display name & avatarChosen by each player joining a room. Visible to other players in the same room only.Kept until the host deletes the room.
Game stateRoom details (code and an encrypted room password), predictions, quiz answers, duel results, points and trophies. Tied to the room and to each player’s anonymous session ID.Kept until the host deletes the room.
Browser & connection dataIP and user-agent for security and abuse prevention. Not used for cross-session tracking.Server logs retained 14 days.

What we do NOT collect

  • No real names, addresses, phone numbers, or payment details. The game is free and there's nothing to bill.
  • No cross-site tracking cookies. No advertising or behavioural profiling.
  • No microphone or camera input. The game is text and tap only.
  • No data sales. Ever. We're not in that business.

Who has access

Eurovision Games runs on two infrastructure providers. They are the only third parties that hold your data.

  • Supabase (Postgres database, auth) — stores room state, anonymous sessions and game data, and handles the email sign-in used only by site administrators. Row-level security policies prevent cross-room data access.
  • Vercel (hosting) — serves the app and retains short-term request logs for security and abuse prevention.
  • No-one else holds your data. No analytics broker, no advertising network, no CRM, no data warehouse, no marketing email. To display the site, your browser may also connect to Google Fonts and load flag images from flagcdn.com; like any web request, these carry your IP address, but no game data.

Your rights

Under GDPR (EU) and UK GDPR, you have the right to:

  • Access — request a copy of the data we hold about you.
  • Rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Erasure — request that we delete your data (the "right to be forgotten").
  • Portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format.
  • Restriction & objection — limit or object to how we process your data.
  • Complaint — lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

Data deletion

How to delete your data

If you created a room, delete it from “Your Rooms” on the home page. The room and everything in it (every player’s display name and avatar, predictions, quiz answers, duel results and points) is removed immediately and can’t be restored. Rooms are not deleted automatically: they stay until the host deletes them. For any other request, email privacy@eurovision.games.

If you joined a room as a guest and want your display name removed, ask the room’s host to delete the room from “Your Rooms”.

Cookies

We use one strictly-necessary category to keep your session alive (anonymous session, room code, language, consent choice). We run no analytics; if we ever add an analytics tool, it will stay off until you opt in. No advertising cookies, no cross-site tracking. Full breakdown on the cookies page.

Children

Eurovision Games is not directed at children under 13. Hosts should be adults; children playing in a hosted room do so under the host's supervision.

Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we'll update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page and post a note in the FAQ. Material changes will be highlighted at the top of this page for at least 30 days.
